correct_completion: we arrived at the meeting on time.
full_sentence: Although the bus was late, we arrived at the meeting on time.
acceptable_variants: we still reached the meeting before it started.
everyone was ready when we came in.

options.text: so we missed the meeting entirely.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, so a result of missing the meeting does not complete the contrast. It describes a cause and effect instead.
This repeats the first clause instead of giving the contrasting action that 'although' expects.

options.text: we arrived at the meeting on time.
we decided to walk home instead.
options.why_wrong: This introduces a new decision that is unrelated to arriving at the meeting, so it does not complete the contrast.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. The main clause should describe a result that is surprising given the late bus.
translation: Otobüs geç kalmasına rağmen toplantıya zamanında vardık.
